messages:
marta: Quick share 1 compact goal + feedback kit that managers and ICs can paste. Designed for cross-functional roles (PM, Eng, Design) and includes a 1-line "elevator" OKR, a 2-line evidence snippet, and 1-line peer DM.

devin: Love the elevator OKR idea. Makes calibration so much faster.
zach: Can you add a tiny example for hiring-related goals? helps managers tie work to hiring plans.
marta: good call 1 added a hiring-linked KR example and a manager follow-up line. Also a checklist for 'evidence vs noise' during calibration.
people-ops-bot: Heads up: calibration meeting next Friday. Use these cards in the packet.

marta: --- ELEVATOR OKR (one-line objective + two KRs, super-short) ---
- Obj: "Increase model serving reliability for high-concurrency customers."
- KR1: "Reduce 99th percentile latency from 820ms to 300ms on 95% of routes."
- KR2: "Cut production error-rate by 60% via rollout policy and fallback paths."

marta: --- 2-LINE EVIDENCE SNIPPET (paste for manager/IC) ---
- "Implemented route-level prefix caching and per-route autoscale; observed 45% reduction in tail latency in staging and no customer regressions during canary."

marta: --- HIRING-ALIGNED KR EXAMPLE (1 line) ---
- "Mentored 2 new infra hires, reduced onboarding time to contribute by 40%, enabling capacity for one extra shard by Q3."

marta: --- MANAGER FOLLOW-UP LINE (1 line) ---
- "Assign a clear owner for the next action and a 3-week checkpoint to validate improvements."

marta: --- PEER FEEDBACK DM TEMPLATES (one-line variants) ---
- Short: "Hey @NAME 1 quick ask: can you share 2 lines on my clarity during the rollout (handoff + responsiveness)? Thanks!"
- Quick praise request: "If you have 30s, could you note one thing I did well on the onboarding project?"

marta: --- CALIBRATION: EVIDENCE VS NOISE (manager checklist, 5 bullets) ---
- Prefer: quant metrics (latency/error/cost) tied to a time-window and dashboard panel.
- Prefer: deployment artifacts (canary results, perf tests) over anecdote-only claims.
- Watch for: team-level signals presented as individual ownership.
- Confirm: peer statements that contradict owner claims; flag for follow-up.
- Action: set 1 measurable follow-up that can be verified within 3 weeks.

devin: This is super useful. One tiny add: a 1-line 'customer impact' phrase for non-technical roles (e.g., "improves self-serve activation").
marta: added small template below.

marta: --- CUSTOMER IMPACT (1 line) ---
- "Improved self-serve activation and reduced first-response support tickets for trial accounts by 30%."

zach: Nice. I'm going to paste this into the calibration packet and add a note to link hiring plan KRs.
marta: Thanks 1 ping me if you want a version tailored to PMs or Designers (I'll swap metrics/examples).
people-ops-bot: Tip: to include these as templates in the review form, file a request to people-ops with the thread_ts.
